da_moovin: Day 4: Leopold "Brick" Moovin reached S-F19 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
A clear shot from S-F19. Leopold "Brick" Moovin grazed Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong and slid back down below the parapet.
jwessels530: Ulrich Jwessels came up the line with a dented harmonica and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. The transfer made Ulrich Jwessels a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself. Ulrich Jwessels bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

On a quiet night Matthias Mart (Concord) and Ulrich Jwessels (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home found Ulrich Jwessels before the night shift. Ulrich Jwessels folded it small and kept it close.
lagbagdotzip: Severin Lagbagdotzip came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Severin Lagbagdotzip fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Shadow" Danny, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. After what happened at Verdel Ridge, Severin Lagbagdotzip asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Part of the parapet collapsed near Severin Lagbagdotzip. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.
pgallo102: Ulrich Pgallo was a tram conductor in Rosenau until the posters went up. He came to S-F5 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake. The transfer made Ulrich Pgallo a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Ulrich Pgallo wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Ulrich Pgallo lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
